ms.report:
Dear Reviewers, 
It is with joy, that after months of talks and conversations about dates and format, we have finally been able to set the date and are fully ongoing for our LEGALTHON, the event we are doing with the UBA, to generate the Research and student/graduate participation we committed in the project.
In the link below you will find all the required information, the UBA confirmation, the list of speakers and agenda, the terms and conditions to participate at the event, the official UBA publication, and several posts by UBA and social media to promote the event.

We hope you find the evidence complete and appropriate, please let us know any questions.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GNE5xb_OyG1LACOY6Op_rvEwbA1q0jHlvBW7e_X1lZM/edit?usp=sharing

Dear Reviewers, 
The event was a complete success and the 3 teams selected (yes 3, instead of 2) are working now with their assigned mentors.
We joy we can share with you our Milestone 2 report.
